newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Metro Pacific unit reports big 1996 growth. [CORRECTED 13:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Metro Pacific unit reports big 1996 growth. [CORRECTED 13:00 GMT]

text.p: Smart Communications Inc said on Monday the number of its cellular phone subcribers grew by 172 percent last year to exceed its target of 300,000 (corrects from 308,000.)
Smart said the exact number of its cellular phone subscribers at the end of 1996 was 308,229, up from 113,000 by the end of 1995 (corrects to give number of subscribers at end of 1996.)
The company attributed the growth to the expanded coverage of its cellular service and wider customer service network.
"We've achieved outstanding results in 1996 that places us in a strong position for continued dominance in the long term," Smart president Orlando Vea said in a statement.
He said Smart now holds 33 percent of the cellular phone market in the Philippines. It is the second biggest cellular phone provider in the country.

Smart, affiliated with First Pacific Co Ltd and Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp, is planning an initial public offering (IPO) of shares this year. It has not yet given details of the planned IPO but has said it plans to sell 15 to 20 percent of its existing share capital.
